plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fixed FLAC stuttering on piCorePlayer — forced 16-bit FLAC output (-sample_fmt s16). ffmpeg was outputting 24-bit FLAC which caused pitch/volume variations and stuttering on live streams. Also added nice -n 10 to ffmpeg and yt-dlp to prevent CPU lockup.
plugin.creator: schmij97
